title: Vanishing square-root logarithmic power
statement: For every natural number $d$, the function $\delta\mapsto \sqrt{\delta}\,\bigl(\log(1/\delta)\bigr)^d$ tends to $0$ as $\delta$ tends to $0$ through positive real values.
hypotheses_covered: $\delta$ tends to $0$ through positive real values
replaced:
For every natural number $d$, with $\log$ denoting the natural logarithm,
\[
\lim_{\delta\to0^{+}}\sqrt\delta\,\bigl(\log(1/\delta)\bigr)^d=0.
\]
